what: Before and after photos are stacked. While the middle of the panel passes from 65% to 45% of the screen, the After photo wipes in from the left over the Before (scroll-bound, no curve). When the wipe reaches .35, the Before label slides up and out, and the After label rises from below over .3 of the wipe, swapping places.

options.[data-fx-part=after]: After photo (child) — sweeps in layered over the top
options.[data-fx-part=label-before]·[data-fx-par: (if present) Swapping label — stacked inside the same mask (overflow:hidden). It may sit outside the plate (searched for within the plate’s ancestor)

note: The original pins the label group beside the panel at 1025px and above, but that is the consuming side’s section layout, so it is not in the part

from.where: staging.html .vs (before/after) — original virtual-staging: #vsImgAfter clip inset(0 100% 0 0)→0 duration 1 none, label yPercent -100 / 100→0 @.35 .3, trigger #vsFrameContainer center 65%→center 45% scrub true
